description: This file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV recipe application. It manages displaying a grid of recipes with focus navigation optimized for TV, includes a search bar for filtering recipes, and handles user interactions such as selecting recipes and performing searches.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a grid of recipe cards with search functionality optimized for Android TV navigation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up focus navigation, item decorations, and search input behaviors.

methods.name: performSearch
methods.description: Filters the recipe list based on the search query.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Updates the adapter with a new recipe list and toggles empty state message.

methods.name: openDetail
methods.description: Navigates to the detail view for the selected recipe.
